item.title: Logan Finance rolls out new product tier for high-balance non-QMs
item.description: Logan Finance launched Open Road Elevated, offering loans of up to $5M across four non-QM programs, including DSCR up to $4.5M.

item.title: Newrez rolls out TitlePass program, waiving lender title insurance on some refis
item.description: Multichannel mortgage lender Newrez has launched Newrez TitlePass for use in its wholesale channel, giving mortgage brokers a way to waive the lender title insurance requirement on certain refinance loans.

item.title: Corcoran Reverie, Housify form luxury valuation partnership
item.description: Corcoran Reverie agents will have exclusive professional access to the platform’s valuation and market analysis tools.

item.title: As brokerage giants merge, Real Estate One bets on the power of local platforms
item.description: Real Estate One CEO Dan Elsea says consolidation is driven by margin pressure, while the firm targets 20% market share with multiple brands.

item.title: Real Brokerage adds top San Diego agent Jason Cassity as chief growth officer
item.description: The Real Brokerage created a chief growth officer role and named San Diego agent and team leader Jason Cassity to lead agent growth and engagement.

item.title: RezeLink AI platform aims to accelerate title search workflows
item.description: The platform will debut first for users of SoftPro — with additional title production system integrations planned for future releases.

item.title: How will rising oil prices impact the U.S. housing market?
item.description: As oil spiked toward $120, the 10-year yield moved to 4.21% then eased to 4.13% while mortgage rates stayed near 6.17%.

item.title: NAR reaffirms MLS autonomy amid Compass-Redfin partnership
item.description: NAR said its statement goes along with its long-standing position that sharing properties on the MLS provides transparency in the marketplace.

item.title: Seniors want to age in place, but family caregivers face strains on multiple fronts
item.description: A Pew Research Center survey of 8,750 U.S. adults found that one in 10 reports serving as a caregiver for a parent age 65 or older.

item.title: West Capital Lending sues loanDepot, alleges unlawful pay scheme
item.description: West Capital Lending has sued loanDepot, accusing the California-based mortgage lender of engaging in a long-running compensation scheme that violates the Truth in Lending Act.
